explainer.title: React the moment something arrives
explainer.description: Optional. Connect an account when an automation should start on a new email or Slack message, or when an agent should call the app's API directly.

apps.title: Hundreds of apps
apps.body: Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, CRMs, calendars — each becomes a set of tools your agents can call.

oauth.title: OAuth sign-in
oauth.body: You sign in on the app's own page. Tokens live in Composio; Godmode only keeps your API key, encrypted.

scoped.title: Scoped accounts
scoped.body: Connect an account for everyone, one workspace, or a single agent — e.g. work vs. personal Gmail.

noConnectors.title: Your apps don't need a connector
noConnectors.description: Godmode signs in to websites the way you do: with the username, password and 2FA code saved in your Vault. It types them into the login page itself, so the AI never sees them. Your CRM, a supplier portal, your shop admin: most sites that open in a browser work right away, without an MCP connector.
noConnectors.hint: Connect an app here only when an automation should start the moment something arrives, like a new email, or for an API without a website.

mcpTest.description: Godmode starts the server, lists its tools and shuts it down again.

mcpTest.noTools: The server started but didn't report any tools.

connections.disconnectDescription: Agents in this scope immediately lose access to this account. You can reconnect it any time.

gallery.label: App gallery
gallery.title: Add an app
gallery.description: Connect an account and your agents get its actions as tools.

gemini.description: Generate and edit images with Nano Banana (Google's Gemini image models): illustrations, product shots, photo edits, images with text.

openai.description: Images with GPT Image (generate and edit), plus OpenAI's GPT models for text and vision, text-to-speech and transcription.

elevenlabs.description: Lifelike speech in many voices and languages, sound effects from a description, and speech-to-text.

replicate.description: Run open models for images (FLUX), video, audio, upscaling and background removal.

perplexity.description: Up-to-date answers from the web with cited sources — research, news, fact checks.

descriptions.anthropic: Optional — otherwise your Claude Code login is used. Set it to bill runs to an API account instead.
descriptions.zai: Optional — for GLM-5.3, only on tasks Claude declines or can't do. Claude stays the default for every agent.
descriptions.openai: Voice: speech-to-text and natural text-to-speech when the OpenAI voice provider is selected.
descriptions.elevenlabs: Voice: premium text-to-speech voices when ElevenLabs is selected.
descriptions.browserUse: Lets profile-use sync your Chrome cookies to a browser-use Cloud profile.
descriptions.captcha: CAPTCHA solving for agents. Saving a key turns it on with this service if none is picked (Settings → Browser).
descriptions.composio: Connects hundreds of apps through Composio.
descriptions.composioUser: Optional — lets app automations receive events when Composio refuses the regular event channel (error 4009). Your personal user API key (uak_…) from Composio's account settings.

apiKeys.encryptedDescription: Keys are sealed in your vault with AES-256-GCM and are never displayed again. Godmode injects them where they're needed — agents don't see them.
apiKeys.agentApiTitle: Want an agent to use an API?
apiKeys.agentApiDescription: These keys power Godmode itself. Keys for agents — Nano Banana, OpenAI, anything — go under Tools.
apiKeys.solverSelected: Agents now send CAPTCHAs to {{solver}} (Settings → Browser).
apiKeys.removeDescription: Features that depend on this key stop working until you add it again.

tools.isOnHint: Agents in scope can use it again.
tools.isOffHint: Agents won't see it until you turn it back on.
tools.description: Give agents any API with your key — image generation, voices, search, your own services. Say what it's for; they work out the calls.
tools.readyToGo: Ready to go — just add your key
tools.anyOtherTagline: Your key, its address and docs
tools.keyHiddenTitle: Agents use the key, they never see it
tools.keyHiddenDescription: Keys are sealed in your vault. Godmode adds them to each request and only sends them to the tool's own address; every call is in the audit log.
tools.removeDescription: Agents lose it from their next message, and its key is deleted from the vault.
tools.emptyDescription: Start with one of these — they come with the address and docs filled in, so all you add is the key.
tools.envVarHint: Runs also get the key in this environment variable
tools.onlySentTo: The key is only sent to {{url}}
